findings.message: The exact baseline bindings are independently valid but never compared with verificationSubject requirements/project-overview/architecture/contract/work-breakdown/work-dependency/specialist-assignment refs, so an approved change can be rebound to a different project baseline before integration.

requiredCorrections: Require every emitted IntegrationInputBinding baseline reference to equal the corresponding immutable baseline reference in the approved ValidatedVerificationSubject; compare full ArtifactRef identity, not only presence or digest syntax.
Update the positive WIV fixture to use those exact intrinsic baseline references in both the verification subject and baseline bindings.
Add one negative per baseline slot proving same-kind, content-valid substitution is rejected before plan construction.
Retain all attempt-004 kind, intrinsic-ID, RepositorySnapshot, evidence, permission, immutable-object, commit-width, and deterministic-plan coverage.
